mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_account (id, ledger_book_id, chart_account_id, owner_type, owner_id, balance_bucket, normal_side, account_status, debit_total, credit_total, net_balance, last_journal_sequence, balance_version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{ledgerBookId}, #{chartAccountId}, #{ownerType}, #{ownerId}, #{balanceBucket}, #{normalSide}, #{accountStatus}, #{debitTotal}, #{creditTotal}, #{netBalance}, #{lastJournalSequence}, #{balanceVersion}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, ledger_book_id, chart_account_id, owner_type, owner_id, balance_bucket, normal_side, account_status, debit_total, credit_total, net_balance, last_journal_sequence, balance_version, create_time, update_time FROM t_account WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT a.id account_id, c.account_code, a.balance_bucket, a.normal_side account_normal_side, c.normal_side chart_normal_side, c.posting_allowed, c.chart_id account_chart_id, a.net_balance FROM t_account a LEFT JOIN t_chart_account c ON c.id = a.chart_account_id WHERE a.ledger_book_id = #{ledgerBookId} AND a.owner_type = #{ownerType} AND a.owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY a.id
